name: Paribus Camelot PNFT instantaneous-position oracle
summary: Paribus's Algebra V1 position oracle valued a Camelot liquidity NFT from the pool's instantaneous globalState price. The attacker flash-borrowed USDT, pushed the thin PBX/USDT pool, minted a position, deposited it into the newly listed PNFT market, borrowed ETH, ARB, WBTC and USDT against the inflated valuation and unwound the swap.
notes: Listing pNFT 0xa26b6df2 with a 20% collateral factor is the last HIGH change on the path: the pool was whitelisted at PNFT creation, the oracle supported it and the Comptroller bound AggregatorOracle 0xa185a8c0 earlier (ref txs); later setV3SupportedPair calls touched other pools.

Gross depletion of the pETH, pWBTC, pARB and pUSDT reserves. The attacker's position NFT left as collateral and its later return of ETH, ARB and USDT to Paribus governance (ref txs) are not subtracted (rule 11).
Separate from Paribus's April 2023 pETH redeem-reentrancy incident: different defect and code.
